relations.subject: server/8.0/eventing/eventing-handler-advancedIncrementOp
relations.evidence: For more information about the Advanced Self-Recursion Parameter, see [Advanced INCREMENT Operation](eventing-advanced-keyspace-accessors.md#advanced-increment-op).

notable_absence.finding: Pure code-sample page demonstrating couchbase.increment(), the mirror image of advancedDecrementOp.md in this same batch. Matches the Capella twin's own call not to mint: 'couchbase.increment/decrement/touch' are not enumerated in eventing:advanced-keyspace-accessor's registry description (which lists only get/upsert/replace/delete/insert), so this record does not force that concept onto this page. 'Counts the mutations subject to DCP deduplication' is standard Data Service/DCP behavior, not an Eventing-specific mechanism - left concepts empty rather than minting a thin per-page concept.
